docs.title: Aliakbar Nafar
docs.text:
Machine Learning Engineer II at BetterHelp · Philadelphia, PAPhD in Computer Science, Michigan State University (defended October 2026)

I build LLM agents and evaluation systems at BetterHelp (Teladoc Health). I defended my PhD at Michigan State University in October 2026, on modeling uncertainty with large language models, as a member of the HLR Lab. NAACL 2025 Outstanding Paper Award.

docs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II @ BetterHelp (Teladoc Health)
docs.text:
Dec 2025 – Present

  • Build an agentic conversational system for the platform under a zero-tolerance requirement on stigmatizing or inappropriate language: architecture, evaluation harness, and safety layer.
  • Built an LLM information-extraction system that turns session and intake data into structured clinical records: auto-filled assessment forms and draft treatment plans for clinician review.
  • Led the evaluation framework and LLM judge behind our EMNLP 2026 paper: clinical taxonomy, judge at F1 93.3 against clinicians, audit of 8 LLMs from four model families. Code and data open-sourced.
  • Set up CI/CD evaluation pipelines for LLM features: regression suites scored by an LLM judge as release gates.
  • Fine-tune LLMs to reduce stigmatizing responses in therapy-related conversations and improve patient-facing alignment.
